meta.title: ServeYourSpace — Your Space. Your Services. Your Way.
meta.description: ServeYourSpace (SYS) is a mobile services marketplace that connects customers with service providers, with ServiBot, its AI assistant.

hero.description: Discover a smarter way to connect with professionals and manage everyday services. Everything your space needs, in one place.
hero.sceneLabel: 3D view of the ServeYourSpace app on a smartphone

cards.botMsg: Need a provider? I can help.

story.title: One app. Every step of the service.

chapters.title: Your space, in your pocket.
chapters.text: Create your profile in a few steps, choose your space as a customer or a provider, and you are ready to go.

chapters.title: Find the right service in seconds.
chapters.text: Search for a service, browse categories or open the service map to see what is available around you.

chapters.title: Built for the professionals too.
chapters.text: Providers follow their daily goal, weekly activity, completed missions and history from a dedicated dashboard.

chapters.title: Ask. Propose. Agree.
chapters.text: Send your request, receive proposals and adjust the price together until the deal feels right on both sides.

chapters.title: And an assistant that listens.
chapters.text: Describe your need in your own words. ServiBot points you to the right kind of professional, close to you.

about.title: More Than a Service Platform.
about.description: ServeYourSpace is an innovative digital ecosystem designed to simplify how people discover, connect with, and manage everyday services.

customers.label: For customers
customers.title: Everything you need, without the hassle.

providers.label: For service providers
providers.title: A professional toolkit in your hand.

showcase.title: Designed to feel effortless.
showcase.description: A tour of the ServeYourSpace application. Screens marked “App screen” are captured from the real app; screens marked “Illustration” show an existing feature redrawn for this page.

home.title: Home
home.desc: A personal welcome, service search and quick access to the service map and categories.

categories.title: Service categories
categories.desc: Plumbing, electrical work, cleaning, gardening and more, each with its own page.

negotiation.title: Request & price negotiation
negotiation.desc: Proposals come in, and the price can be raised in one tap with suggested amounts.

chat.title: Messaging
chat.desc: Customers and providers talk in real time about every mission.

dashboard.title: Provider dashboard
dashboard.desc: Daily goal, weekly activity, completed and ongoing missions, history and balance.

servibot.title: ServiBot AI assistant
servibot.desc: A conversational assistant with quick suggestions to find the right provider.

profile.title: Profile
profile.desc: Personal information, contact details and account settings in one place.

signup.title: Sign-up
signup.desc: A guided profile creation in three short steps.

otp.title: Email verification
otp.desc: A 6-digit code sent by email secures every new account.

settings.title: Three languages
settings.desc: The app speaks French, English and Arabic, with full right-to-left support.

menu.title: Navigation
menu.desc: Requests, messages, notifications, payments and transactions, one tap away.

servibot.description: ServiBot lives inside the ServeYourSpace app. Instead of searching through menus, you simply tell it what you need, and it helps you move forward.

capabilities.title: Talk naturally
capabilities.text: Write your request the way you would say it. No keywords, no forms.

capabilities.title: Find a provider
capabilities.text: Ask for a professional and ServiBot guides you to the right type of provider.

capabilities.title: Close to you
capabilities.text: Looking for someone nearby? Ask ServiBot for providers around your position.

capabilities.title: Describe a problem
capabilities.text: Not sure who to call? Describe the problem and ServiBot helps you figure it out.

chat.name: ServiBot
chat.user1: I have a leak under my kitchen sink. Who should I call?
chat.bot1: That sounds like a job for a plumber. Would you like to see plumbers available near you?
chat.bot2: Great. Open the service map to see plumbers around you and send your request.

suggestions.title: Provider
suggestions.text: Need a provider to help you?

suggestions.title: Describe a problem
suggestions.text: I have a problem and I don't know who to turn to.

services.title: Every service your space needs.
services.description: From urgent repairs to everyday care, ServeYourSpace brings the right professionals to your door.

plumbing.name: Plumbing
plumbing.desc: Leaks, installations and repairs handled by plumbers near you.

electrical.name: Electrical services
electrical.desc: Wiring, outlets, lighting and fault repairs, done safely.

painting.name: Painting
painting.desc: Walls, ceilings and finishes to give your space a new look.

cleaning.name: Cleaning
cleaning.desc: Home cleaning at your rhythm, from a quick refresh to a deep clean.

carpentry.name: Carpentry
carpentry.desc: Doors, furniture and woodwork, built and repaired with care.

gardening.name: Gardening
gardening.desc: Lawns, plants and outdoor spaces kept healthy all year.

maintenance.name: Home maintenance & repairs
maintenance.desc: Glazing and small repairs to keep everything working.

tutoring.name: Private tutoring
tutoring.desc: Lessons at home with teachers who adapt to you.

hairdressing.name: Home hairdresser
hairdressing.desc: A professional cut and styling without leaving home.

coaching.name: Sports coach
coaching.desc: Personal training sessions where and when it suits you.

how.title: Four steps. Zero friction.
how.description: From the first search to the finished job, ServeYourSpace keeps it simple.

steps.label: Discover
steps.title: Find the service you need.
steps.text: Search, browse categories or ask ServiBot.

steps.label: Connect
steps.title: Connect with the right service provider.
steps.text: Pick a professional close to you and send your request.

steps.label: Negotiate
steps.title: Discuss your requirements and negotiate the service details.
steps.text: Chat, receive proposals and agree on a fair price.

steps.label: Enjoy
steps.title: Get your service completed.
steps.text: Follow the mission until it is marked as done.

vision.title: Building a Smarter Way to Experience Everyday Services.
vision.intro: ServeYourSpace is a young technology startup with a simple belief: getting help at home should be as easy as sending a message.

mission.label: Our mission
mission.text: Simplify access to everyday services through an accessible, connected, and intelligent digital platform.

vision.label: Our vision
vision.text: Build a smarter ecosystem that connects customers and service providers through technology and innovation.

values.name: Innovation
values.text: We use technology, including AI, where it truly makes life easier.

values.name: Simplicity
values.text: Every screen is designed to be understood at first glance.

values.name: Trust
values.text: Verified accounts and clear exchanges between customers and providers.

values.name: Accessibility
values.text: Three languages, light and dark mode, for everyone.

values.name: Digital transformation
values.text: Bringing everyday services into the digital age.

cta.title: Your Space Deserves Better.
cta.description: Discover a smarter, simpler, and more connected way to manage your everyday services.

footer.description: ServeYourSpace connects customers with service providers through a simple, multilingual mobile app and an AI assistant, ServiBot.
